scope: 30 lesson quizzes and browser-saved reading, draft answers, last graded results, resume and review on /learn/.
content: Questions authored from existing published lesson definitions, steps, structure, FAQs and misconception corrections. Each explanation links back to the corresponding lesson section and its existing reference list. No new external technical claims or company data added.
flow: Concept quiz/read control → validated client reducer → dedicated localStorage key → restored quiz and learning dashboard. No server account, new API or remote progress transmission.

persistence.reading: Explicit completion/undo; visiting or submitting a quiz does not silently complete reading.
persistence.quiz: Partial answers auto-save. Latest completed result is retained while a retry draft is in progress. Score is derived from validated answers, not a saved numeric score.
persistence.resilience: Unknown IDs/options/invalid attempts sanitized. A changed quiz revision invalidates old quiz attempts but retains reading history. Unreadable/newer root records are not overwritten. Read/write failures keep an in-memory session with a user-facing notice.
persistence.tabs: Fresh persisted state read before each write; storage events refresh another tab. Changes to different lessons merge; simultaneous edits to the same field use the last write.
persistence.limitations: Device/browser/origin only; no cloud sync. Clearing browser data removes records. Temporary fallback cannot survive a full navigation/reload.

verification.httpLearning: 30/30 pages, 90 questions, 270 native radio inputs, review targets, reading buttons and dashboard PASS
verification.existingContentRegression: 30/30 concept explanations, numbers/citations, structure, misconceptions, FAQ, connections and navigation PASS

verification.storageFailureTestLevel: Automated fake-storage tests; the browser storage API was not forcibly disabled.
verification.reactReview: Scoped client components, compact manifest props, memoized context and stable dispatch, effect cleanup, hydration-safe initial state, native fieldsets/radios, explicit feedback and keyboard focus.

application: Verify original hashes and repository remote, back up existing changed files, copy only manifest paths, then run original npm run check. Completion is recorded in the application result artifact.
delivery: Local project changes; no dependency installation, commit, push or external deployment. QA uses port 3102 to isolate test progress from the user preview on 3101.
